note: What a server sends to set where a missile starts from and how fast it travels, which restarts its flight. The header names the missile.

fields.name: driver
fields.note: How the missile is driven; only 1, homing, exists, and for any other value nothing after the velocity is read.

fields.name: fromX
fields.note: Where the missile starts, in world units, along one ground axis.

fields.name: fromY
fields.note: Where the missile starts, in world units, in height.

fields.name: fromZ
fields.note: Where the missile starts, in world units, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: velocityX
fields.note: How fast it travels, in world units a second, along one ground axis.

fields.name: velocityY
fields.note: How fast it travels, in world units a second, in height.

fields.name: velocityZ
fields.note: How fast it travels, in world units a second, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: kind
fields.note: Must be 1, or the block below is ignored.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The unit homed on.

fields.name: height
fields.note: Added to the target's height.

fields.name: targetX
fields.note: The point homed on, which the client refreshes from the target while it exists.

fields.name: targetY
fields.note: Its height.

fields.name: targetZ
fields.note: Its other ground axis.

fields.name: motionA
fields.note: A value of the homing motion; what it does is not recorded.

fields.name: motionB
fields.note: Another.

fields.name: motionC
fields.note: Another.

fields.name: motionD
fields.note: Another.

fields.name: last
fields.note: Kept with the homing; what it does is not recorded.

fields.name: unused
fields.note: Unused; a server writes zero.
